PASS on the fake backend (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: no human reviewed or tested it and no hardware was attached or run. This package implements the card's first AST entry symbol env_humanoid:BDXEnv only; the card's other entry symbols (simple_env:BDXEnv, footsteps_env:BDXEnv, env:BDXEnv) and the two further BDXEnv classes are named in facts.md and not implemented. The upstream environment was not run: it imports placo and builds its scene from the absolute path /home/antoine/MISC/mini_BDX/mini_bdx/robots/bdx/scene.xml, outside the clone; the sim backend (gymnasium.make("BDX_env") after an upstream registration) was not run either. The fake is a kinematic F0 stand-in: 13 action values per env_humanoid.py:24-36, a 41-value observation per :92, the upstream effective reward formula and the +/-0.01 reset noise. NOT COVERED: the pinned model's neck_pitch and two antenna actuator channels; the declared 41-value observation corresponds to 13 joints (20 qpos + 19 qvel + 2 contacts), while the 15-joint robot.xml would give 45 values, so the upstream declared space and its model disagree. The fake's action box boundaries (-1..1) are placeholder test data: the real box is built by gymnasium's external MujocoEnv and is not stated in the clone, so the derived action.values limits are not a sourced device limit. No hardware stop, no operator-required limit, no site-limits overlay, no native.py and no fixtures; only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed is applied by the next reset), four G7.MAYBE_ABSENT (action_space, observation_space, reset and close are inherited from the external MujocoEnv; the names occur elsewhere in the clone and the gate downgrades them), and four G8.NO_UNIT (seed twice, ticks and action.values). There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the stable digest line the check printed.
